repairs.quote: Morgana chains herself to nearby enemy Champions, dealing (200/275/350 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing them by 20%. After 3 seconds, enemies unable to break the chains take an additional (200/275/350 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage and are Stunned for 1.5/1.75/2 seconds. While casting this Ability, Morgana gains 20/40/60% Move Speed. Morgana gains True Sight of all enemies affected by this Ability.
